environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no application-layer inspection. The NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP) and passes all HTTP traffic directly to the container. No WAF is attached. The backend internal-service runs on the same task definition and accepts connections on port 3001. The service uses Node.js 18 with http module default settings which accept both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers simultaneously.

config.network: same VPC, no network ACL restrictions between services
